In our proposed workflow, we put a lot of emphasis on the plate design and management.
The plate will carry all information needed not only for bioanalytical purposes, but also the pharmacokinetic information needed for the study.


```{r}
library(PKbioanalysis)
```


```{r}
newstudy <- data.frame(
  type = "SD",
  pkstudy = TRUE,
  title = "New Study",
  description = "Description of the new study",
  subject_type = "Human"
)
new_study <- create_new_study(newstudy)
```
